DET.note: Young core led by Cunningham, Thompson, Holland. Movable mid-tier contracts. Cap flexibility for trades.

ORL.note: Young core with Banchero, Wagner, Suggs. Over first apron, but under second apron for flexibility.

TOR.note: Young core with Barnes, Quickley, Barrett, plus Kawhi. Poeltl's contract is a bad deal.

DAL.note: Young core with Flagg, Lively, plus Anthony Davis. Injury concerns for Irving and Lively. Potential trade deadline sellers.

HOU.note: Young core with veteran stars Durant, VanVleet. Tari Eason's new deal impacts cap. Aiming for contention.

MIN.note: Core of Edwards, Ball, Gobert. Over first apron, limiting flexibility.

OKC.note: Elite young core (SGA, Holmgren, Jalen Williams). Under second apron, offering trade flexibility.

POR.note: Ja Morant leads young core. Lillard returning from Achilles. Building through trades, not free agency.

SAS.note: Deep young core (Wemby, Castle, Harper). Significant cap flexibility for trades/additions.
